summary.text: Andrew Marschall is a Republican member of the North Dakota House of Representatives, representing District 16 (West Fargo) in the 2025-26 Legislative Assembly. The legislature's biography lists Andrew Marschall's service as "House since 2017". The member page lists Andrew Marschall's committee assignments as including the Education and the Energy and Natural Resources standing committees.

paragraphs.text: The biography lists Andrew Marschall's occupation as Retired.
It lists education as BS, Occupational Education; AA Business, Automotive Tech.
It lists military service as Air National Guard, (2.5 years); Air Force, (22 years).
It lists these affiliations and civic roles: DAV; VFW; American Legion; NRA.
Andrew Marschall is listed as having 1 child.
